run_rules: -I -B required; no arguments; nothing at import beyond stdlib imports/constants/definitions. All verified source loading occurs inside explicit run; pinned bytes only, non-main namespaces. Fault proxies load a separate namespace of the same verified reader and delegate real native operations. Native handles retained before post-call fault; exact dev/ino identities and original iterator objects retained; at most one owning close, no number-reuse inference. Instrumentation is labelled, never kernel provenance. Iterator count refers to explicit close; native iterator may internally close at EOF.

Capture callback may raise labelled Exception/BaseException before acquisition. First public read mutates caller input refs for isolation test. No private ledger access, fixed third-report/second-tick timing or forwarding/count/cap assertions.
